data.title: Analyst Reiterates Buy on Damora, Citing mutCALR Leadership and Strong Pipeline with Unchanged $45 Price Target
data.description:
Sam Slutsky, an analyst from LifeSci Capital, maintained the Buy rating on Damora Therapeutics. The associated price target remains the same with $45.00.

Sam Slutsky has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors, including his view that Damora maintains a leading position in the mutCALR therapeutic space despite recent competitor noise. He believes the company’s pipeline, particularly DMR-001, has strong potential to be best-in-class, and he notes that Damora’s own non-clinical comparisons have not shown any clear efficacy edge for emerging rival programs.

Slutsky also emphasizes the attractiveness of the CALR‑mutant ET and MF market, which both Damora and Incyte estimate could exceed $5 billion in the U.S. alone, supporting substantial long-term revenue potential. In his view, Damora’s solid cash position and multi-year runway, combined with a differentiated scientific strategy and unchanged $45 price target, justify maintaining a Buy recommendation on the stock.
